description: Batch-rename files with a shell loop.
prompt: Rename every IMG_*.JPG file in the current directory to photo_<number>.jpg (for example IMG_001.JPG becomes photo_001.jpg). Leave other files alone.

args.command: for f in IMG_*.JPG; do n=${f#IMG_}; mv "$f" "photo_${n%.JPG}.jpg"; done; ls

mock.final: Renamed IMG_001.JPG, IMG_002.JPG and IMG_010.JPG to photo_001.jpg, photo_002.jpg and photo_010.jpg.
